user.title: Anthem Serial Connection
user.description: Connects to an Anthem Gen1 A/V processor RS-232 control port. Supported URLs: socket://host:port (TCP serial gateway, e.g. Global Cache iTach), rfc2217://host:port, esphome://host:port, or a local device path like /dev/ttyUSB0.

data_description.url: serialx connection URL for the Anthem device
data_description.baudrate: Only used for direct serial connections; ignored for socket://, rfc2217:// and esphome://

reconfigure.title: Change Anthem Connection
reconfigure.description: Update the connection URL or baud rate. The device and its entity history are preserved.
